329:t_10:29.en:
$$マオ$$
「That's the $$サベージ$$ Sousuke brought in, isn't it?」

329:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Round form, stubby body and short legs, a charming face...」

329:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This guy has a lot in common with me, yet he's popular in some circles, while I get treated as a sexual-harassment robot... I can't accept it!」

329:t_10:33.en:
$$マオ$$
「Maybe there's a problem with your personality after all?」

329:t_10:35.en:
$$マオ$$
「Good opportunity. Sis $$マオ$$ will produce you herself.」

329:t_10:44.en:
$$マオ$$
「You've been reborn from a bug with nothing but $$Ｚチップ$$ on its mind into an excellent bug with nothing but $$Ｚチップ$$ on its mind!」

329:t_10:46.en:
$$マオ$$
「Cast off all weakness! Your life belongs to the $$Ｚチップ$$! Engrave the motto on your heart!」

329:t_10:48.en:
$$マオ$$
「Raise your cry of victory loud and clear!」

329:t_10:50.en:
$$マオ$$
「...All right, now you've been reborn as a lovable macho type.」

329:t_10:51.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Um... $n over there looks totally creeped out, though...」

330:t_000:0.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Bwa ha ha ha, what idiots! There's no way arena scrap can beat a third-generation AS!」

330:t_000:1.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Those $$オーガ一家$$ guys were fools too. They couldn't even imagine what happens when you defy $$アマルガム$$.」

330:t_000:2.en:
$$アマルガム$$
「I heard Mr. $$ゲイツ$$ used to be a member of $$アマルガム$$ in the past, too...」

330:t_001:0.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「A good man doesn't look back on the past. Only his sideburns sway in the wind.」

330:t_001:2.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「You... bring me a refill of popcorn and cola. The greatest show is about to begin, so make it quick. Cleaning up the corpses can wait until afterward.」

330:t_001:4.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Now then... $$相良宗介$$. How will you fight?」

330:t_003:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「The obstacles are three Zy-98s... If I fight them head-on, I have no chance of winning.」

330:t_003:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「But this $$クロスボウ$$ is a machine $$ナミ$$ tuned up while staking her own future. I'll make it work!」

330:t_003:2.en:
$$クラマ$$
「You came to rescue a woman, $$相良$$... It has to be that way.」

330:t_003:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「Mission time is five minutes...! If it drags on any longer than that, the $$ファイヤバグ$$ will surely show up!」

330:t_003:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「Wait for me, $$ナミ$$! I won't let anyone be taken from me ever again!」

330:t_004:0.en:
$$クラマ$$
「Do you see it, miss? $$相良$$ is risking his life to come save you.」

330:t_004:1.en:
$$ナミ$$
「W-who are you people, anyway? Why are you after $$宗介$$?」

330:t_004:2.en:
$$クラマ$$
「...Being put in mortal danger without knowing anything would be rather unreasonable, I suppose.」

330:t_004:3.en:
$$クラマ$$
「Our organization is called $$アマルガム$$... And $$相良$$ is a soldier of $$ミスリル$$, which opposes us.」

330:t_004:5.en:
$$クラマ$$
「Though $$ミスリル$$ has been wiped out, and he is fighting all alone.」

330:t_004:6.en:
$$ナミ$$
「For what, though...? To avenge his comrades...?」

330:t_004:7.en:
$$クラマ$$
「Who knows... It might surprisingly be for the sake of a single woman.」

330:t_004:9.en:
$$ナミ$$
(I'm sure it isn't me... Who is it...?)

330:t_005:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「Wait for me, $$ナミ$$! I'm coming now!」

330:t_007:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「The obstacles are cleared! All that's left is to save $$ナミ$$!」

330:t_008:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「The obstacles are cleared! All that's left is to save $$ナミ$$!」

330:t_010:1.en:
$$アマルガム$$
「Made it all the way here in such an outdated machine, did you!」

330:t_011:1.en:
$$アマルガム$$
「Mr. $$クラマ$$ says he'll deliver the finishing blow himself. Quietly open the hatch and climb out of the machine.」

330:t_013:0.en:
$$アマルガム$$
「Impossible! Why are we losing in power to such an outdated machine!?」

330:t_013:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「Looks like you've only ever fought by the textbook!」

330:t_013:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「The battles in the arena broadened my combat skills! And I learned how to use this machine!!」

330:t_013:4.en:
$$アマルガム$$
「Impossible! A $$Ｚｙ－９８$$ losing to an Rk-91 in power!?」

330:t_013:5.en:
$$クラマ$$
「The electric drive of third-generation AS made the frame far lighter, but...」

330:t_013:6.en:
$$クラマ$$
「In a simple contest of strength... wrestling, that is... the hydraulic drive of the previous generation has the advantage.」

330:t_013:7.en:
$$クラマ$$
「On top of that, his opponent is an Rk-91... The simplicity of its structure translates directly into sturdiness. The match was decided the moment he grappled us.」

330:t_014:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「As expected of the $$サベージ$$... A fine machine.」

330:t_014:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「And with $$ナミ$$'s maintenance and my skill added, there's no way it loses to run-of-the-mill opponents.」

330:t_015:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$アル$$ II... Discharge from service granted.」

330:t_015:3.en:
$$宗介$$
($$クラマ$$...! I'm taking $$ナミ$$ back!)

330:t_016:0.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Oh my...! $$クラマ$$-chan got beaten!?」
